text:
dan_m: Heads up — Ancora invoice INV-3589 (USD 48,120) failed 3x this morning. Customer called and needs same-day payment; asked if we can accept a wire today. cc @maria_f @ryan_payments

payments-bot: Charge failed: tx_9f3a... | acquirer=globalpay | decline_code=issuer_declined | reason=insufficient_funds | attempts=3 | last_attempt=2026-03-23T10:12:04Z

maria_f: Can you confirm card brand + last4 and whether they used invoice link or stored card?

dan_m: Card is Visa ending 9176. They used the hosted invoice link twice and our billing portal once. Customer rep: Emily L.

ryan_payments: I pulled the logs — three declines across two acquirers (globalpay + stripe-connect). Codes: issuer_declined, risk_block. Pattern looks like either issuer-level block or SCA/risk flow failing. No AVS mismatch.

olivia_ops: If customer insists on wire, finance needs to approve manual exception + we need a signed wire authorization. @maria_f can you approve?

maria_f: Approve manual wire option for Ancora (enterprise account, at-risk). We need GL code and approver name in the ticket. Also ask CS to confirm authorized signer and send a remittance/proof of transfer once wired.

tina_cs: On it. I've contacted Emily — she prefers to wire today. She asked if we can try one more card retry before they start the wire.

ryan_payments: We can do one manual retry but only if customer re-authenticates the card (re-enter CVC) via the hosted update link — otherwise retry will likely fail and trigger more risk blocks. My recommendation: send secure card update link + schedule a single immediate manual retry if token is updated.

dan_m: Customer says accounting needs same-day settlement and would prefer wire. What's the wire template we send?

maria_f: I'll paste the standard wire instructions (non-PCI, public-facing) below — send over secure channel or include in the invoice email. Replace placeholders with our finance ops reference.

```
WIRE TO:
Bank: Meridian Commercial Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Account #: 0123456789
Routing (ACH): 026009593
SWIFT/BIC: RWDXUS33
Reference: INV-3589 / Ancora Ltd.
Notes: Please attach SWIFT/payment advice to the reply.
```

tina_cs: Sending the secure payment link and the wire template to Emily now. She said she'll get the treasury team to initiate the wire and send payment confirmation.

ryan_payments: I'll put a temporary hold on automatic retries for INV-3589 to avoid duplicate collection attempts. Once we receive SWIFT confirmation, finance can mark it applied.

maria_f: GL code 4102, approver maria_f. Once we have payment evidence (SWIFT + value date), we'll clear the invoice and reconcile.

dan_m: @payments-bot can you mute automatic retries for inv_3589?

payments-bot: Auto-retries disabled for inv_3589 by ryan_payments at 2026-03-23T11:25:20Z.

tina_cs: Customer uploaded remittance advice to secure ticket (https://secure.redwood/t/12345). I'll update when funds settle.

maria_f: Thanks team — high priority on avoiding churn here. If wire falls through, we'll revisit manual card retry with re-auth.
